name: arisultima/overwatch-laravel-agent
description: Counts what happens inside a Laravel app and pushes one small report a minute to an Overwatch server.

suggest.laravel/horizon: Adds a horizon health check and supervisor status to each report.
suggest.laravel/pulse: Detected at run time only; nothing is read from it unless present.
suggest.laravel/fortify: Counts failed two-factor challenges from its events.
suggest.spatie/laravel-permission: Counts role and permission changes from its events.
